name: notification-center
description:
Notifications in the header and on their own page, driven by props and callbacks (no server state).

- **`NotificationMenu`**: the bell — an icon `GlanceTrigger` whose `GlanceIndicator` shows the unread count (also in the button's name). It opens a panel with the recent items, "Mark all as read" (`onMarkAllAsRead`), loading and empty states and a "View all" link (`viewAllHref`). `size="sm"` makes the bell 32px, for a compact top bar.
- **`NotificationList`**: every notification as cards with a read/unread `Badge`, for a page paired with `Pagination`.
- **`NotificationItem`**: an unread dot (or an `icon`), the title — a link when it has `href`, calling `onOpen` — the message, the date (formatted in the `I18nProvider` locale) and icon buttons for `onMarkAsRead` and `onDelete`, described by the title.
- **Composing items**: give `NotificationMenu` or `NotificationList` a function as `children` and return a `NotificationItem` with its parts — `NotificationItemMedia` (an icon or avatar with the unread dot), `NotificationItemContent`, `NotificationItemTitle`, `NotificationItemMessage`, `NotificationItemDate` and `NotificationItemActions` (more `NotificationItemAction`s as its children). The list's handlers and variant still apply.

Urgent notifications are a `ConfirmDialog` opened with `useDialogPromise`.

Built-in text is in English; override it with `i18n.labels`.
